claims.kind: lacking scale printed (UK, EU) / length column: foot
claims.claim: Reebok Australia's size guide prints men's and women's footwear charts with US, UK, EU, CM, and INCH columns; the same page says its measurement is the foot's length and to apply it to the size chart.
claims.exact_words: Men's Footwear US UK EU CM INCH ... This measurement represents the length of the foot. ... Apply the longer of the two measurements to our size chart to find the right correlating size for the recorded foot length.
claims.notes: Cells in charts.csv (men's 24 rows, women's 14 rows). The CM column is not itself labelled 'foot length'; the page's measuring text ties the chart to the foot length. Reebok's AU site is run for the brand in Australia; flagged as a regional site.

claims.claim: Paper taped to a hard floor, stand with weight even, a helper marks big toe tip and outermost heel, measure between the marks; repeat for the other foot.
claims.exact_words: With a pen or pencil pointed straight down, have a friend or partner assist you by marking the tip of the big toe and the outermost part of the heel. Once the marks are recorded, step off the paper and use a ruler or tape measure to measure the distance between the two points. This measurement represents the length of the foot. Repeat the process with the other foot. Please note that it is common for one foot to be a slightly different length to the other.
claims.notes: Big toe, not longest toe, in the AU words.

claims.exact_words: If the measurement is between sizes, we recommend sizing up.
claims.notes: Not found on the US or CA pages.

claims.claim: Club C runs narrower: size up 0.5; all other ranges true to size.
claims.exact_words: Fit Note Club Cs tend to be more narrower so we recommend sizing up 0.5. All other ranges are true to size and we recommend picking your usual size.

claims.claim: US unisex guide: heel against a wall, mark the longest toe on both feet, measure in inches, take the larger and compare with the chart, whose length column is Heel-Toe Measurement (in).
claims.exact_words: Place a piece of paper on a hard floor with one end to the wall. Stand on the piece of paper with the heel slightly touching the wall. ... Mark the end of your longest toe with a pencil for both feet. ... Measure your markings in inches. Take the larger of the two foot length values and compare it with our sizing chart.
claims.notes: Chart columns: U.S. Men Size | U.S. Women Size | Heel-Toe Measurement (in) (read in the earlier pass).

claims.claim: Canada: the same three steps, the larger foot length compared with the chart; the chart's top row is Heel-toe measurement in inches.
claims.exact_words: Measure your marketing from the wall (heel) to the longest toe for both feet. Take the larger of the two foot length values and compare it with our sizing chart, to define your Reebok shoe size.
claims.notes: 'marketing' is the page's typo for 'markings'. The CA chart prints US women 7.5 then 7 at the 9" and 9.2" columns (as printed).

claims.claim: Reebok Canada's Winter Boots Sizing prints Euro against Canada/US for women's and men's boots, some as ranges.
claims.exact_words: Winter Boots Sizing Women's Boots Euro Canada/US 36 5 - 5 ½ ... M en's Boots Euro Canada/US 40 7 ... 42 8 ½ - 9
claims.notes: Cells in charts.csv. Scope: winter boots only, as printed.
